proposal_contribution:
Four contributions. All are TEXT for the proposal file; no brain edit is made or implied.

(1) THE ABSORBED FINAL PHASE MUST NOT BE CONSUMED AS A DIRECTION TILT - and there is a BLIND-AVAILABLE form of the test. Doctrine already says absorbed flow is not a direction signal, but the blind cannot see price and so cannot compute flow_conviction. The blind-available surrogate is a THREE-LIMB CONJUNCTION, all of it in never-masked tape_conditions: (a) the D-1 FINAL phase carries the session's largest signed flow in one direction; (b) the guard-clean big-print cohort leans the OTHER way; (c) the resting book (quote_bid_share) leans the same way as the big prints, not the aggressor flow. When all three hold, the final-phase flow is being absorbed and must be dropped as a tilt. G23 instance: 0706 ph3 sflow -1,207 (session max), big_print_b_share 0.593 on n=85 guard-clean (the block's highest), quote_bid_share 0.512 bid-leaning -> next session +160 UP, against a blind -350 built on that exact flow. HONEST STATUS: n=1 at the full three-limb conjunction. It is the negative-flow sibling of flow.price_free_absorption_proxy, whose positive-flow arm is already at n=2 (G20 0602/0603) - so the MECHANISM is established, only this polarity is new. Requires a second group's instance before it is anything more than a candidate.

(2) THE REFUTED MIRROR ARM MAY SURVIVE AT AN EXTREME BAR (candidate, n=2 SPANNING GROUPS). flow.price_free_absorption_proxy declares its mirror arm REFUTED at the 0.50 bar on five datapoints (0527 .529 -> +2,100; 0528 .522 -> -160; 0604 .533 -> -1,340; 0603 .476 -> +1,130; 0611 .572 -> +620). G23 adds a sixth: 0706 .593 -> +160. At the 0.50 bar the refutation stands - three up, two down, no ordering. But sort the six by big_print_b_share and the only two readings at or above 0.57 are 0611 (.572, G21) and 0706 (.593, G23), and BOTH printed up. That is n=2 spanning two groups. HONEST STATUS: the bar is drawn post-hoc from a six-point set, which is exactly the tent-widening the operating discipline forbids as a conclusion. It is proposed ONLY as a PRE-COMMITTED forward test - fire on raw big_print_b_share >= 0.57 under negative aggregate session flow, guard-clean sample, and log the outcome in G24+ before any promotion. The play's HALF_ONLY scope is not to be relaxed on this.
